items.summary: Recommend rejecting all new admissions, monetization expansion, and spend. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites. September AI usage is $950.44418695 across 5,316 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but it is not period-comparable to one revenue day. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, forecasts, and causal lift are not calculable. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and measurement work; authorize no spend, billing change, money movement, or monetization expansion.

Reject the proposed allthingsmasonic.com experiment and AI-tooling research admission this cycle. The first has 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; the second has no cost-savings or outcome evidence. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Retain them only as deferred, non-executing specifications after capacity clears and after a dated financial baseline exists.
